info.description: One row per user who has opted in to the affiliate program. Owns the referralCode + its enable/disable lifecycle + the per-affiliate commission kill switch (commissionsEnabled).

referralCode.description: URL-safe uppercase alphanumeric slug. Auto-generated codes are 10 chars via crypto.randomBytes → Crockford's base32. Custom user-chosen codes range 4-16 chars; both paths run through the same normalisation (O→0, I→1, L→1, U→V) so lookups never diverge. Old code stops resolving immediately on rotation.

status.description: active = code resolves + signup attribution live. disabled = code returns 404 at click endpoint + signup attribution ignored. terminated = same as disabled + never re-enable-able (soft-delete).

disabledReason.description: Free-text admin note. Not exposed to the affiliate themselves.

lastCodeRotationAt.description: Rate-limit signal — front-end can throttle the self-service regenerate button.

commissionsEnabled.description: Per-affiliate commission kill switch. When false, new deposits by this affiliate's referrals do not accrue commission. Previously accrued rows remain intact.

commissionsDisabledReason.description: Admin-only note explaining why per-affiliate commissions were turned off.

lastActivityIpHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the affiliate's most recent authenticated public IP. Used ONLY for self-referral detection — the signup IP hash of a new referral is compared against this. Never leaves the server. Refreshed opportunistically on any /affiliates/me/* endpoint hit.

lastActivityAt.description: When lastActivityIpHash was last updated. Self-referral check requires this to be within a 24h window — stale IPs (dynamic ISPs, changed carriers) don't false-positive-block future legitimate referrals.
